description: Draft a governance-compliant GitHub issue for HUMAN review — never submitted (AI-governance / Human-In-The-Loop contract). draft_governance_issue assembles a local Markdown draft plus a structured compliance report and validates it against the zero-dependency + reproduction policy. The server has NO network code path and NO GitHub write path: present the returned draft and compliance report to the user, then STOP — they review and submit it manually under their own GitHub identity. Engine behaviour targets 'zipnative'; wrapper behaviour targets 'zipnative-mcp'. Fully self-contained (no archive needed).

arguments.title: scan_zip_forward mis-detects the descriptor of a stored entry
arguments.summary: A stored entry followed by a signed data descriptor is reported as truncated by the forward reader, while the same archive opens and verifies cleanly through the random-access path.

reproduction.command: scan_zip_forward on an archive written with compression.method 'store' and stream: true on one entry
reproduction.result: ZIP_STREAM_TRUNCATED at the stored entry; verify_zip on the same bytes reports ok: true

arguments.expectedBehavior: The entry is read and its CRC verified, or refused with ZIP_UNSUPPORTED_CD_LESS_DESCRIPTOR rather than reported as truncated.
arguments.actualBehavior: The scan stops with ZIP_STREAM_TRUNCATED although the stream is complete.
